# Clean Path Credit

> Bilingual (English / Spanish) credit repair and restoration company serving Texas — focused on San Antonio and Houston. Operates under the Credit Repair Organizations Act (CROA), the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), and Texas Finance Code Chapter 393. No advance fees. 3-day right to cancel. Contact: hello@cleanpathcredit.com · (346) 399-5606.

Clean Path Credit audits consumer credit reports across Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion, identifies items that appear inaccurate, incomplete, or unverifiable, and files disputes on the consumer's behalf under FCRA §611 (credit bureau disputes) and §623 (furnisher disputes). The company does not charge advance fees (prohibited by CROA §404), provides the Consumer Credit File Rights notice before any contract is signed, and honors a 3-day unconditional right to cancel (CROA §405). Clean Path Credit does not remove accurate, verifiable information and does not promise specific score increases or guaranteed outcomes.

Services are delivered remotely (service-area business, by appointment) and are available in English and Spanish.

## Are credit repair companies legal?
Yes. In the United States, credit repair is regulated by the Credit Repair Organizations Act (CROA), which requires a written contract, prohibits charging fees before services are performed, mandates a 3-day right to cancel, and forbids guaranteed-outcome claims. The disputes a credit repair company files are the same rights consumers hold themselves under FCRA §611. A legitimate company cannot remove accurate, verifiable information or guarantee a specific credit score.
